Title: Reserved capacity on Azure SQL Database Hyperscale is now available

Body.Content:
The new reserved capacity offer for Azure SQL Database Hyperscale enables discounts on your compute costs when you make a one- to three-year commitment for Azure SQL Database when using the vCore purchasing model.

Learn how charges for reservation purchases are applied by reading documentation on Azure reservation usage for your Enterprise enrollment and your Pay-As-You-Go subscription.
